Expose an extension point so downstream apps can attach their own Guzzle middleware without forking the SDK.

### Added

- `TelegramBotClient::extendHandlerStack(HandlerStack $stack): void` — protected hook called after the SDK's own middleware (`connect_retry`, `obfuscated_logger`, `http_errors`, `retry_after`) and before the underlying Guzzle Client is built. Subclasses can push observability or tracing middleware (Sentry spans, OpenTelemetry, custom logging) by overriding it.

### Changed

- `TelegramBotClient` is no longer `final`. Subclassing is the supported way to use the new hook.
